scope: Independent presentation engine source; Linux Chromium full Vue app, not a desktop installer validation

checks: New presentation opens independently and saves a real one-slide PPTX ZIP
Text editing, arrow movement, pointer dragging, resizing and undo/redo change the actual slide
Saved OOXML independently contains edited text, exact geometry, a native table and chart values
Saved PPTX reopens with editable text, table cells and chart values; a second save retains edits
Exported PDF independently reopens with three readable pages and searchable Chinese text
Original rich PPTX imports three slides with real image, table, chart and preserved notes
Twenty-slide PPTX imports, selects its last slide and preserves both hidden slides in saved OOXML
Shift+F5, next/hidden-page skipping, Home, End, Escape and F5 use the built-in slideshow
Editor remains usable without document overflow at 640, 900 and 1360 pixels
Unsaved tab switching preserves edits; close cancel keeps them, save closes a real file, and discard closes explicitly
Codec creates a standard OOXML package with master, layout and theme
Rich sample imports inherited geometry, tables and chart data; unchanged dependencies and original buffers survive two saves
The 20-page fixture preserves its original centered-title geometry, including source-authored overlap on slide five
Changing an imported layout preserves inherited master artwork, background, placeholder geometry and theme text style
Text, table, chart, notes, hidden slides, duplicate and reorder survive independent import/export with unique IDs
Group move, resize, rotation and absolute child geometry survive real OOXML export/import
New editable tables declare the standard OOXML table graphicData URI for independent office readers
Effects and media retain original transition XML, timing metadata and embedded bytes
Editing notes replaces multiple ordinary text shapes without duplicating their old text
Unsupported SmartArt is explicitly locked and its original diagram parts remain intact
DTD in unrecognized extensions, macro packages, signed packages and relationship traversal are rejected
Independent ZIP inspection confirms edited chart values live in real embedded XLSX workbooks
Production codec passes direct fixture round trips and independent embedded-workbook readback in the same browser
Entire PPT session has zero iframes, Office/WASM runtime loads, external requests and page/console errors
